entries.title: Ezekiel 3:1
segments: ¶Moreover he said unto me, Son of man, eat that thou findest; eat this roll, and go speak unto the house of Israel.

entries.title: Ezekiel 3:2
segments: So I opened my mouth, and he caused me to eat that roll.

entries.title: Ezekiel 3:3
segments: And he said unto me, Son of man, cause thy belly to eat, and fill thy bowels with this roll that I give thee. Then did I eat [it]; and it was in my mouth as honey for sweetness.

words.text: [it]; and it was in my mouth

entries.title: Ezekiel 3:4
segments: And he said unto me, Son of man, go, get thee unto the house of Israel, and speak with my words unto them.

entries.title: Ezekiel 3:5
segments: For thou [art] not sent to a people of a strange speech and of an hard language, [but] to the house of Israel; {of a...: Heb. deep of lip, and heavy of tongue}

words.text: ; {of a...: Heb. deep of lip, and heavy of tongue}

segments: Not to many people of a strange speech and of an hard language, whose words thou canst not understand. Surely, had I sent thee to them, they would have hearkened unto thee. {of a...: Heb. deep of lip, and heavy of language} {Surely...: or, If I had sent thee, etc. would they not have hearkened unto thee?}

entries.title: Ezekiel 3:7
segments: But the house of Israel will not hearken unto thee; for they will not hearken unto me: for all the house of Israel [are] impudent and hardhearted. {impudent...: Heb. stiff of forehead, and hard of heart}

words.text: unto me: for all the house

entries.title: Ezekiel 3:8
segments: Behold, I have made thy face strong against their faces, and thy forehead strong against their foreheads.

entries.title: Ezekiel 3:9
segments: As an adamant harder than flint have I made thy forehead: fear them not, neither be dismayed at their looks, though they [be] a rebellious house.

entries.title: Ezekiel 3:10
segments: Moreover he said unto me, Son of man, all my words that I shall speak unto thee receive in thine heart, and hear with thine ears.

entries.title: Ezekiel 3:11
segments: And go, get thee to them of the captivity, unto the children of thy people, and speak unto them, and tell them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; whether they will hear, or whether they will forbear.

words.text: thee to them of the captivity

entries.title: Ezekiel 3:12
segments: Then the spirit took me up, and I heard behind me a voice of a great rushing, [saying], Blessed [be] the glory of the LORD from his place.

entries.title: Ezekiel 3:13
segments: [I heard] also the noise of the wings of the living creatures that touched one another, and the noise of the wheels over against them, and a noise of a great rushing. {touched: Heb. kissed}

entries.title: Ezekiel 3:14
segments: So the spirit lifted me up, and took me away, and I went in bitterness, in the heat of my spirit; but the hand of the LORD was strong upon me. {in bitterness: Heb. bitter} {heat: Heb. hot anger}

words.text: upon me. {in bitterness: Heb. bitter} {heat: Heb. hot anger}

entries.title: Ezekiel 3:15
segments: Then I came to them of the captivity at Telabib, that dwelt by the river of Chebar, and I sat where they sat, and remained there astonished among them seven days.

entries.title: Ezekiel 3:16
segments: ¶And it came to pass at the end of seven days, that the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

words.text: ¶And it came to pass at the end

entries.title: Ezekiel 3:17
segments: Son of man, I have made thee a watchman unto the house of Israel: therefore hear the word at my mouth, and give them warning from me.

entries.title: Ezekiel 3:18
segments: When I say unto the wicked, Thou shalt surely die; and thou givest him not warning, nor speakest to warn the wicked from his wicked way, to save his life; the same wicked [man] shall die in his iniquity; but his blood will I require at thine hand.

words.text: ; and thou givest him not warning

entries.title: Ezekiel 3:19
segments: Yet if thou warn the wicked, and he turn not from his wickedness, nor from his wicked way, he shall die in his iniquity; but thou hast delivered thy soul.

entries.title: Ezekiel 3:20
segments: Again, When a righteous [man] doth turn from his righteousness, and commit iniquity, and I lay a stumblingblock before him, he shall die: because thou hast not given him warning, he shall die in his sin, and his righteousness which he hath done shall not be remembered; but his blood will I require at thine hand. {righteousness which: Heb. righteousnesses}

words.text: : because thou hast not given him warning

entries.title: Ezekiel 3:21
segments: Nevertheless if thou warn the righteous [man], that the righteous sin not, and he doth not sin, he shall surely live, because he is warned; also thou hast delivered thy soul.

words.text: not, and he doth not sin

entries.title: Ezekiel 3:22
segments: ¶And the hand of the LORD was there upon me; and he said unto me, Arise, go forth into the plain, and I will there talk with thee.

words.text: was there upon me; and he said

entries.title: Ezekiel 3:23
segments: Then I arose, and went forth into the plain: and, behold, the glory of the LORD stood there, as the glory which I saw by the river of Chebar: and I fell on my face.

entries.title: Ezekiel 3:24
segments: Then the spirit entered into me, and set me upon my feet, and spake with me, and said unto me, Go, shut thyself within thine house.

entries.title: Ezekiel 3:25
segments: But thou, O son of man, behold, they shall put bands upon thee, and shall bind thee with them, and thou shalt not go out among them:

words.text: thee with them, and thou shalt not go out

entries.title: Ezekiel 3:26
segments: And I will make thy tongue cleave to the roof of thy mouth, that thou shalt be dumb, and shalt not be to them a reprover: for they [are] a rebellious house. {a reprover: Heb. a man reproving}

words.text: And I will make thy tongue
to the roof of thy mouth
, and shalt not be to them a reprover

entries.title: Ezekiel 3:27
segments: But when I speak with thee, I will open thy mouth, and thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; He that heareth, let him hear; and he that forbeareth, let him forbear: for they [are] a rebellious house.
